name: Moonlit Prism Serpent Palace
introDiscord: A palace of prism coral divides moonlight into colors that do not seem to exist anywhere else. Every corridor has six reflections, and long Serpents glide through the light leaving copies of themselves behind.
introTwitch: A palace of prism coral divides moonlight into colors that do not seem to exist anywhere else. Every corridor has six reflections, and long Serpents glide through the light leaving copies of themselves behind.

spectrum-gate.prompt: Prism coral frames three entrances beneath the Spectrum Gate. Each route divides into impossible colors while Serpent afterimages glide through the walls.

left.message: A Fae vessel appears red from one angle, blue from another, and completely invisible from a third. You approach from the fourth and recover Star Candies.

right.message: One Prism Serpent enters the hall. Seven Serpents appear in the walls. Only one lunges. Very considerate of the other six.

forward.message: Shizuki's Prismwater elixir reads: "Every color tastes suspicious in a different way. Purple is lying."
forward.fullHpMessage: The Prismwater elixir remains untouched. You are already at full health, and purple can keep whatever lie it was preparing.

refraction-hall.prompt: Prism pillars multiply every movement around you. Three passages appear as twenty-one. This seems excessive.

left.message: Seven overlapping maps lie beneath one Berry. Six are labeled 'DECOY.' The seventh is labeled 'ALSO POSSIBLY DECOY.' Shizuki's confidence remains inspiring.

right.message: A Moonkeeper cache appears behind three false walls. Walking directly toward the least plausible wall somehow works. Inside: Star Candies.

forward.message: A Serpent reflection passes left. Another passes right. The real Serpent comes from above because apparently mirrors are merely suggestions.

prismcoil-arcade.prompt: The arcade curves through shifting color. Three exits trade places every few seconds while Serpents weave through their own afterimages.

left.message: A Serpent coils through a prism beam and splits into six colored copies. Five disappear when they strike. Guessing which one matters becomes urgent.

right.message: Shizuki's bottle reads: "Refraction trick: one pursuer, seven false Shizukis. Drawback: seven Shizukis all look equally lost."
right.fullHpMessage: Shizuki's refraction remedy remains sealed. At full health, seven equally lost versions of you would only complicate matters.

forward.message: A moon-shell coffer repeatedly changes color to match the floor. You finally catch it when it turns an extremely unhelpful neon green and recover Star Candies.

boss-antechamber.name: Empress Kaleidoscope
boss-antechamber.prompt: The Palace opens into a central kaleidoscope where every corridor reflects every other. Countless colored coils turn around one empty patch of floor.

bossPromptDiscord:
Every color in the Palace converges into the central chamber.

The walls reflect one enormous coil.

Then another.

Then dozens.

Only one shadow touches the floor.

Use /yes to face the Empress or /no to leave before you have to guess which thirty-foot Serpent is real.
bossPromptTwitch:
Every color in the Palace converges into the central chamber.

The walls reflect one enormous coil.

Then another.

Then dozens.

Only one shadow touches the floor.

Use !yes to face the Empress or !no to leave before you have to guess which thirty-foot Serpent is real.
bossRetreatText: You leave Empress Kaleidoscope before choosing among the enormous reflected coils. The Palace immediately adds another false corridor behind you.

boss.revealText: The only coil casting a shadow slides from the kaleidoscope walls. The Prismatic Coil Empress reveals herself!

completionText: The Prismatic Coil Empress withdraws into the Palace's highest prism. The false corridors collapse back into three real ones. Shizuki's maps remain somehow less accurate.
